summary: Tested Family/Caregiver feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 18 pytest cases pass covering invite reuse, accept errors (own/bad/used code), accept success + already_linked duplicate, patients/caregivers lists, readings fetch with 403 when not linked, 14-day timestamp filtering + desc sort, and bidirectional unlink that revokes readings access. UI flow verified on mobile viewport (390x844): Settings → 'Family & caregivers' (settings-caregivers), Dashboard button (open-caregivers-button) both route to /caregivers; cg-gen generated 8-char code shown in cg-invite-code; caregiver entered it via cg-code-input + cg-accept → patient appeared as patient-row-0; tapping it opened /caregiver-view with cgv-name='Alex', 11 glucose rows (cgv-g-0..) and 6 BP rows (cgv-bp-0..). cgv-alert banner correctly hidden when latest reading is in range and shown when latest glucose = 3.0 mmol/L (Low). No deprecated expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected. No React Native red-screen errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1900+ lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, readings, caregivers, pharmacy, admin) per the >700 line guideline.
Caregiver links use status='active'/'removed' soft-delete which is correct; readings endpoint properly filters last-14-days by timestamp and sorts desc.

api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL as mentioned in the review request). The actual env key in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — this is correct for Expo but the system-prompt doc references EXPO_BACKEND_URL; worth noting (not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Reused existing +15550001234/1234 (Alex, patient) and +15550009999/4321 (TestUser, caregiver). Seeded glucose readings 3.1, 5.8, 3.0 mmol/L and BP 132/84 on patient to drive the caregiver view and alert check. context_for_next_testing_agent: Caregiver flow fully exercised. Pytest file must be run WITHOUT xdist parallel (ordered class-based shared_state): `pytest backend/tests/test_caregivers.py -v -o addopts=''`. The link between Alex and TestUser is currently ACTIVE after this run; if a future test needs it absent, unlink via DELETE /api/caregivers/link/{id} first or use fresh accounts.
